paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc fell one point short against Tishomingo County on Thursday, Oct. 29, losing 43–42 at home in Ecru. MaxPreps lists the contest as a final, with the Braves taking the road conference win.

The result leaves the Vikings at 4–6 overall and Tishomingo County at 5–4. North Pontotoc had won 22–15 at South Pontotoc the previous Friday, Oct. 23; our earlier county football report is linked below.

North Pontotoc is scheduled to visit Senatobia for a playoff game at 7 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, according to MaxPreps. The matchup appears on both schools’ current schedules. Supporters should check the linked game listing for changes.
